title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
高老汉和三花

    高老汉和三花，是村里有名的人，他们都很爱算命。高老汉有一本算命书，他做什么事都要先算一算；三花每个月一号，都要拿出她的那朵大红花，戴在头上，打扮成天神，给人算命。
    高老汉最不喜欢的是别人说“不适合种地”，这里面有个小故事：有一年春天，很多天都没有下雨了，大家都希望下雨。因为不下雨的话，他们不能种地。终于，五月三号那天下了一点点雨。于是，四号那天大家都忙着种地。但是高老汉看了看他的算命书，又算了一下，说：“今天不适合种地。”所以，他那天没有种地。第二天，五号，他又算了一下，还是不适合种地，所以他又没有种地。到了六号，他又算了一下，六号适合种地！高老汉很高兴，马上跑去种地。但是地已经干了，很难种。后来，别人家的菜都长出来了，只有高老汉家的地里什么都没有。有个年轻人看到高老汉，问他：“高老汉，今天适不适合种地呀？”大家大笑。后来，大家一看到高老汉就喜欢和他开玩笑，问他：“高老汉，今天适不适合种地呀？”高老汉每次被这么开玩笑，都很难过。
    再来说三花。三花为什么要打扮成天神呢？
    那时三花才十五岁，刚刚和水生结婚。在他们村里，结婚了还和别的男人玩的女人，她是第一个。每天她的丈夫水生去种地，家里就只有三花一个人。村里的年轻人们觉得三花一个人在家没事做，就经常来和她玩。他们每天在一起大声说笑。水生觉得这样很不好，有一天他生气了，不让那些年轻人们来家里了。这下三花不高兴了。她哭了一天，不吃不喝，睡在床上，谁叫都不起来。第二天正好是一月一号，她拿出一朵很大很大的红花，戴在头上，打扮成天神，对她的丈夫水生说，有天神住进了她的身体里。
    她对水生说：“我现在是天神，你看到天神，还不快点站起来？”
    水生是一个很相信天神的人。他一看是天神在说话，很害怕，马上站了起来。
    “天神”又说：“以后，我每个月一号都会住进三花的身体里面。你要对三花好，三花说什么，你就做什么，因为三花说的话就是我说的话，知道了吗？”
    水生忙点点头，说：“知道了，请您放心！”
    从那以后，三花说什么，水生就做什么。三花每个月一号都会拿出她的那朵大红花，戴在头上，打扮成天神。慢慢地，村里的人们开始到她这儿来算命。年轻人们也会去她那儿算命。但是，年轻人们说是去算命，其实就是想和她玩儿。三花知道他们心里想的是什么，所以衣服穿得越来越漂亮，打扮的时间越来越久，让年轻人们的眼睛都离不开她。
    这是三十年前的事了。当时的年轻人们现在很多都结婚了，家里面有妻子有孩子，不再到三花那儿去了。三花却和大家不同，虽然已经四十五岁了，却比以前更爱漂亮：衣服和鞋子上一定要有花，颜色一定要大红、大绿。但是，现在漂亮的衣服穿在三花身上，大家还是可以看得出她已经不年轻了。
    老情人们都不来了，没关系！因为三花家现在又来了很多新的小伙子们，比当年的老情人更多、更好。
    为什么小伙子们喜欢到三花那儿呢？这还要从一个叫多喜的人说起。
fullText.traditional:
高老漢和三花

    高老漢和三花，是村裡有名的人，他們都很愛算命。高老漢有一本算命書，他做什麼事都要先算一算；三花每個月一號，都要拿出她的那朵大紅花，戴在頭上，打扮成天神，給人算命。
    高老漢最不喜歡的是別人說“不適合種地”，這裡面有個小故事：有一年春天，很多天都沒有下雨了，大家都希望下雨。因為不下雨的話，他們不能種地。終於，五月三號那天下了一點點雨。於是，四號那天大家都忙著種地。但是高老漢看了看他的算命書，又算了一下，說：“今天不適合種地。”所以，他那天沒有種地。第二天，五號，他又算了一下，還是不適合種地，所以他又沒有種地。到了六號，他又算了一下，六號適合種地！高老漢很高興，馬上跑去種地。但是地已經乾了，很難種。後來，別人家的菜都長出來了，只有高老漢家的地裡什麼都沒有。有個年輕人看到高老漢，問他：“高老漢，今天適不適合種地呀？”大家大笑。後來，大家一看到高老漢就喜歡和他開玩笑，問他：“高老漢，今天適不適合種地呀？”高老漢每次被這麼開玩笑，都很難過。
    再來說三花。三花為什麼要打扮成天神呢？
    那時三花才十五歲，剛剛和水生結婚。在他們村裡，結婚了還和別的男人玩的女人，她是第一個。每天她的丈夫水生去種地，家裡就只有三花一個人。村裡的年輕人們覺得三花一個人在家沒事做，就經常來和她玩。他們每天在一起大聲說笑。水生覺得這樣很不好，有一天他生氣了，不讓那些年輕人們來家裡了。這下三花不高興了。她哭了一天，不吃不喝，睡在床上，誰叫都不起來。第二天正好是一月一號，她拿出一朵很大很大的紅花，戴在頭上，打扮成天神，對她的丈夫水生說，有天神住進了她的身體裡。
    她對水生說：“我現在是天神，你看到天神，還不快點站起來？”
    水生是一個很相信天神的人。他一看是天神在說話，很害怕，馬上站了起來。
    “天神”又說：“以後，我每個月一號都會住進三花的身體裡面。你要對三花好，三花說什麼，你就做什麼，因為三花說的話就是我說的話，知道了嗎？”
    水生忙點點頭，說：“知道了，請您放心！”
    從那以後，三花說什麼，水生就做什麼。三花每個月一號都會拿出她的那朵大紅花，戴在頭上，打扮成天神。慢慢地，村裡的人們開始到她這兒來算命。年輕人們也會去她那兒算命。但是，年輕人們說是去算命，其實就是想和她玩兒。三花知道他們心裡想的是什麼，所以衣服穿得越來越漂亮，打扮的時間越來越久，讓年輕人們的眼睛都離不開她。
    這是三十年前的事了。當時的年輕人們現在很多都結婚了，家裡面有妻子有孩子，不再到三花那兒去了。三花卻和大家不同，雖然已經四十五歲了，卻比以前更愛漂亮：衣服和鞋子上一定要有花，顏色一定要大紅、大綠。但是，現在漂亮的衣服穿在三花身上，大家還是可以看得出她已經不年輕了。
    老情人們都不來了，沒關係！因為三花家現在又來了很多新的小伙子們，比當年的老情人更多、更好。
    為什麼小伙子們喜歡到三花那兒呢？這還要從一個叫多喜的人說起。

sentences.traditional: 對她的丈夫水生說，有天神住進了她的身體裡。
sentences.pinyin: duì tā de zhàng fu shuǐ shēng shuō yǒu tiān shén zhù jìn le tā de shēn tǐ lǐ
sentences.english: .. and told her husband Shuisheng that a god lived in her body.

sentences.simplified: 她对水生说：“我现在是天神，你看到天神，还不快点站起来？”
sentences.traditional: 她對水生說：“我現在是天神，你看到天神，還不快點站起來？”
sentences.pinyin: tā duì shuǐ shēng shuō wǒ xiàn zài shì tiān shén nǐ kàn dào tiān shén hái bú kuài diǎn zhàn qǐ lai
sentences.english: She said to Shuisheng, “I’m a god now. You’re looking at a god, why aren’t you standing up?”

sentences.simplified: 水生是一个很相信天神的人。
sentences.traditional: 水生是一個很相信天神的人。
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ shēng shì yí ge hěn xiāng xìn tiān shén de rén
sentences.english: Shuisheng was someone who really believed in gods.

sentences.simplified: 他一看是天神在说话，很害怕，马上站了起来。
sentences.traditional: 他一看是天神在說話，很害怕，馬上站了起來。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí kàn shì tiān shén zài shuō huà hěn hài pà mǎ shàng zhàn le qi lai
sentences.english: As soon as he saw that a god was speaking, he was very afraid and immediately stood up.

sentences.simplified: “天神”又说：“以后，我每个月一号都会住进三花的身体里面。
sentences.traditional: “天神”又說：“以後，我每個月一號都會住進三花的身體裡面。
sentences.pinyin: tiān shén yòu shuō yǐ hòu wǒ měi ge yuè yī hào dōu huì zhù jìn sān huā de shēn tǐ lǐ miàn
sentences.english: The “god” then said, “From now on, I will be in Sanhua’s body on the first day of every month.

sentences.simplified: 你要对三花好，三花说什么，你就做什么，
sentences.traditional: 你要對三花好，三花說什麼，你就做什麼，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yào duì sān huā hǎo sān huā shuō shén me nǐ jiù zuò shén me
sentences.english: You have to be good to Sanhua, and do whatever she says.

sentences.simplified: 因为三花说的话就是我说的话，知道了吗？”
sentences.traditional: 因為三花說的話就是我說的話，知道了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi sān huā shuō de huà jiù shì wǒ shuō de huà zhī dào le ma
sentences.english: Because what Sanhua says is what I say. Do you understand?”

sentences.simplified: 水生忙点点头，说：“知道了，请您放心！”
sentences.traditional: 水生忙點點頭，說：“知道了，請您放心！”
sentences.pinyin: shuǐ shēng máng diǎn diǎn tóu shuō zhī dào le qǐng nín fàng xīn
sentences.english: Shuisheng nodded hurriedly and said, “I understand, please rest assured!”

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，三花说什么，水生就做什么。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，三花說什麼，水生就做什麼。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu sān huā shuō shén me shuǐ shēng jiù zuò shén me
sentences.english: From then on, Shuisheng did whatever Sanhua said.

sentences.simplified: 三花每个月一号都会拿出她的那朵大红花，戴在头上，打扮成天神。
sentences.traditional: 三花每個月一號都會拿出她的那朵大紅花，戴在頭上，打扮成天神。
sentences.pinyin: sān huā měi ge yuè yī hào dōu huì ná chū tā de nà duǒ dà hóng huā dài zài tóu shang dǎ ban chéng tiān shén
sentences.english: On the first of every month, Sanhua would take out her big red flower, put it on her head, and dress up as a god.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，村里的人们开始到她这儿来算命。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，村裡的人們開始到她這兒來算命。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de cūn lǐ de rén men kāi shǐ dào tā zhè‘r lái suàn mìng
sentences.english: Slowly, the people in the village started coming to her for fortune-telling.

sentences.simplified: 年轻人们也会去她那儿算命。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人們也會去她那兒算命。
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng rén men yě huì qù tā nà'r suàn mìng
sentences.english: The young men would also visit her for fortune-telling.

sentences.simplified: 但是，年轻人们说是去算命，其实就是想和她玩儿。
sentences.traditional: 但是，年輕人們說是去算命，其實就是想和她玩兒。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nián qīng rén men shuō shì qù suàn mìng qí shí jiù shì xiǎng hé tā wán'r
sentences.english: The young men said they came for the fortune-telling, but in fact, they wanted to have fun with Sanhua.

sentences.simplified: 三花知道他们心里想的是什么，所以衣服穿得越来越漂亮，
sentences.traditional: 三花知道他們心裡想的是什麼，所以衣服穿得越來越漂亮，
sentences.pinyin: sān huā zhī dào tā men xīn li xiǎng de shì shén me suǒ yǐ yī fu chuān de yuè lái yuè piào liang
sentences.english: Sanhua knew what they were thinking, so she dressed more and more beautifully, ..

sentences.simplified: 打扮的时间越来越久，让年轻人们的眼睛都离不开她。
sentences.traditional: 打扮的時間越來越久，讓年輕人們的眼睛都離不開她。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ ban de shí jiān yuè lái yuè jiǔ ràng nián qīng rén men de yǎn jing dōu lí bù kāi tā
sentences.english: .. and it took longer and longer for her to get dressed. The young men couldn’t tear their eyes from her.

sentences.simplified: 这是三十年前的事了。当时的年轻人们现在很多都结婚了，
sentences.traditional: 這是三十年前的事了。當時的年輕人們現在很多都結婚了，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì sān shí nián qián de shì le dāng shí de nián qīng rén men xiàn zài hěn duō dōu jié hūn le
sentences.english: This happened thirty years previously. Many of the men who were young at the time had now gotten married, ..

sentences.simplified: 家里面有妻子有孩子，不再到三花那儿去了。
sentences.traditional: 家裡面有妻子有孩子，不再到三花那兒去了。
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ miàn yǒu qī zi yǒu hái zi bú zài dào sān huā nà'r qù le
sentences.english: .. with a wife and children at home, and no longer visited Sanhua.

sentences.simplified: 三花却和大家不同，
sentences.traditional: 三花卻和大家不同，
sentences.pinyin: sān huā què hé dà jiā bù tóng
sentences.english: Yet Sanhua was different from other people.

sentences.simplified: 虽然已经四十五岁了，却比以前更爱漂亮：
sentences.traditional: 雖然已經四十五歲了，卻比以前更愛漂亮：
sentences.pinyin: suī rán yǐ jīng sì shí wǔ suì le què bǐ yǐ qián gèng ài piào liang
sentences.english: Although she was now forty-five years old, she wanted to look beautiful even more than ever:

sentences.simplified: 衣服和鞋子上一定要有花，颜色一定要大红、大绿。
sentences.traditional: 衣服和鞋子上一定要有花，顏色一定要大紅、大綠。
sentences.pinyin: yī fu hé xié zi shang yí dìng yào yǒu huā yán sè yí dìng yào dà hóng dà lǜ
sentences.english: She had to have flowers on her clothes and shoes, and the colors had to be bright red and bright green.

sentences.simplified: 但是，现在漂亮的衣服穿在三花身上，大家还是可以看得出她已经不年轻了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，現在漂亮的衣服穿在三花身上，大家還是可以看得出她已經不年輕了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài piào liang de yī fu chuān zài sān huā shēn shang dà jiā hái shi kě yǐ kàn de chū tā yǐ jīng bù nián qīng le
sentences.english: But now when Sanhua wore beautiful clothes, everyone could see that she wasn’t young anymore.

sentences.simplified: 老情人们都不来了，没关系！
sentences.traditional: 老情人們都不來了，沒關係！
sentences.pinyin: lǎo qíng rén men dōu bù lái le méi guān xi
sentences.english: It didn’t matter that none of her old lovers came around anymore!

sentences.simplified: 因为三花家现在又来了很多新的小伙子们，
sentences.traditional: 因為三花家現在又來了很多新的小伙子們，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi sān huā jiā xiàn zài yòu lái le hěn duō xīn de xiǎo huǒ zi men
sentences.english: Because many new young guys now came to Sanhua’s house, ..

sentences.simplified: 比当年的老情人更多、更好。
sentences.traditional: 比當年的老情人更多、更好。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ dāng nián de lǎo qíng rén gèng duō gèng hǎo
sentences.english: .. and compared to her old lovers from back then, there were even more of them and they were even better.

sentences.simplified: 为什么小伙子们喜欢到三花那儿呢？这还要从一个叫多喜的人说起。
sentences.traditional: 為什麼小伙子們喜歡到三花那兒呢？這還要從一個叫多喜的人說起。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me xiǎo huǒ zi men xǐ huan dào sān huā nà'r ne zhè hái yào cóng yí ge jiào duō xǐ de rén shuō qǐ
sentences.english: Why did young guys like coming to Sanhua’s place? This starts with someone called Duoxi.

sentence_translations: Gao Laohan and Sanhua
Gao Laohan and Sanhua were well-known in the village, and they both loved fortune-telling.
Gao Laohan had a fortune-telling book, and always read his fortune before doing anything.
On the first day of every month, Sanhua would take out her big red flower, ..
.. put it on her head, dress up as a god, and tell people’s fortune.
Gao Laohan’s least favorite thing was other people saying “not suitable for farming”, and there’s a story behind this.
One spring, it didn’t rain at all for many days. Everyone really hoped that it would rain.
Because if it didn’t rain, they couldn’t farm. Finally, it rained a little on the third of May.
As a result, everyone was occupied with farming on the fourth.
But Gao Laohan looked at his fortune-telling book, read the fortune again, and said, ..
.. “Today is not suitable for farming.” So, he didn’t farm that day.
The next day, the fifth, he read the fortune again, and it still wasn’t suitable for farming. So he still didn’t farm.
The sixth came and he read the fortune again. The sixth was suitable for farming!
Gao Laohan was very happy, and immediately went out to farm.
But the land had already become dry and was very hard to farm.
Subsequently, the vegetables planted by the other families grew, ..
.. and only the land of Gao Laohan’s family didn’t grow anything at all.
A young man saw Gao Laohan and asked, ..
.. “Gao Laohan, is today suitable for farming?” Everyone laughed heartily.
Afterward, everyone liked to make fun of Gao Laohan whenever they saw him.
They would ask, “Gao Laohan, is today suitable for farming?”
Being laughed at like this made Gao Laohan feel very sad every time.
Let’s talk about Sanhua. Why would Sanhua dress up as a god?
At the time, Sanhua was only fifteen years old and had just married Shuisheng.
She was the first woman in their village who still had fun with other men after getting married.
Her husband Shuisheng went to farm the land every day, and Sanhua was alone at home.
The young men in the village thought that Sanhua was at home by herself with nothing to do, ..
.. so they often came to have fun with her.
They chatted and laughed loudly together every day.
Shuisheng thought that this was very bad, and one day he became angry.
He didn’t let the young men come into the house. This made Sanhua unhappy.
She cried the whole day, didn’t eat or drink, and stayed in bed. No one could make her get up.
The next day happened to be the first of January.
She took out an extremely large red flower, put it on her head, dressed up as a god, ..
.. and told her husband Shuisheng that a god lived in her body.
She said to Shuisheng, “I’m a god now. You’re looking at a god, why aren’t you standing up?”
Shuisheng was someone who really believed in gods.
As soon as he saw that a god was speaking, he was very afraid and immediately stood up.
The “god” then said, “From now on, I will be in Sanhua’s body on the first day of every month.
You have to be good to Sanhua, and do whatever she says.
Because what Sanhua says is what I say. Do you understand?”
Shuisheng nodded hurriedly and said, “I understand, please rest assured!”
From then on, Shuisheng did whatever Sanhua said.
On the first of every month, Sanhua would take out her big red flower, put it on her head, and dress up as a god.
Slowly, the people in the village started coming to her for fortune-telling.
The young men would also visit her for fortune-telling.
The young men said they came for the fortune-telling, but in fact, they wanted to have fun with Sanhua.
Sanhua knew what they were thinking, so she dressed more and more beautifully, ..
.. and it took longer and longer for her to get dressed. The young men couldn’t tear their eyes from her.
This happened thirty years previously. Many of the men who were young at the time had now gotten married, ..
.. with a wife and children at home, and no longer visited Sanhua.
Yet Sanhua was different from other people.
Although she was now forty-five years old, she wanted to look beautiful even more than ever:
She had to have flowers on her clothes and shoes, and the colors had to be bright red and bright green.
But now when Sanhua wore beautiful clothes, everyone could see that she wasn’t young anymore.
It didn’t matter that none of her old lovers came around anymore!
Because many new young guys now came to Sanhua’s house, ..
.. and compared to her old lovers from back then, there were even more of them and they were even better.
Why did young guys like coming to Sanhua’s place? This starts with someone called Duoxi.
